title: Chapter 196 Profit
content:
Chapter 196 Profit

King Wei was still dreaming his own dream, but as the commander and initiator of this expedition, Zhong Yu was not in such a good mood.

Due to Qin's sudden action this time, Zhong Yu's original plan was disrupted. He originally planned to send troops in two directions, so he had to lead all the troops to South Korea, preparing to support the disabled South Korea.

Originally agreed to unite the six countries, South Korea has been completely disabled, and asking him to join the alliance is a complete joke.

In today's South Korea, according to Zhong Yu's estimate, the remaining people are probably no more than 20,000 to 30,000 people. It is not enough for this kind of people to stay in South Korea to guard the country. If they are sent to the expedition, they will be cannon fodder.

Naturally, Zhong Yu's original plan was to use the interests of other countries to let them compete with each other for Qin's territory, and after Qin was defeated, they would stir up their own conflicts and let them fight each other.

In this way, after two large-scale battles, the seven countries in the south will be severely damaged, and the strength of each country may not be half of what it was before the war.

During this period, Yuguo continued to plunder the population of the Central Plains, and recruited all kinds of talents to enrich Yuguo.

And among them, the more forces to join, the better, the more people, the more complicated the mind.

Therefore, South Korea must never fall down. He must stand up again and set an example to tell other countries that Yuguo will not give up any member of the alliance.

In this way, the hearts of all countries can be reassured, so that they can fight with peace of mind, without worrying about their own strength being greatly damaged, and no one will help them afterwards, and they will be completely devastated.

"His Royal Highness the King of Wei, I have heard about the name for a long time, and seeing him today, I am sure she is very elegant!" Zhong Yulang laughed a few times, and said to King Wei in front of him.

"Where is it? His Royal Highness King Jing has been famous for a long time. Only after meeting him will he know that the rumors are true!" Wei Wang also greeted with a smile on his face.

"Trouble King Wei greets you, it's really neglectful!" Zhong Yu said a few words on the occasion.

"Hey, His Royal Highness King Jing is able to run for our countries, that's the real hard work, so what if you greet him a few times!" Wei Wang waved his hand and said disapprovingly.

"Doesn't the king of Wei bring the army of more than 100,000 to rescue South Korea with the lonely king?" Zhong Yu asked curiously.

"Uh, well, there are only a few tens of thousands of remnant soldiers left in the Qin army in South Korea. With the bravery of the soldiers of the Imperial Kingdom, after going to South Korea, they can be wiped out with just a single turn of the hand. Why do the soldiers of the State of Wei need to do so much?" Being asked this suddenly, King Wei was a little embarrassed.

"Then Wei Guo has gathered so many troops, where is his thinking going?" Since it is not to save South Korea, then there must be other purposes, Zhong Yu sneered in his heart.

"The state of Qin and the state of Wei are feuds. Over the years, they have seized the territory of the state of Wei one after another. On this golden opportunity, this king wants to lead a large army, regain the lost land, join forces with other countries, and destroy Qin in one fell swoop!" King Wei said spontaneously.

"Then, does King Wei want to go to Dongjun?" Zhong Yu still had some displeasure on his face.

"Exactly, Dongjun is the territory that Wei State lost not long ago. The people still miss Wei State all the time, so naturally they should take it back sooner!" Wei Wang said with a look of reason.

"That is to say, we are fighting life and death in the front, and His Royal Highness Wei Wang is taking advantage of it in the back. Where do you put us!" Zhong Yu's face was angry on the surface, but his tone was full of accusations.

Regarding the thoughts of these princes and kings, Zhong Yu was prepared in his heart long before the start of the alliance, so naturally he was not really angry with them.

"Well, my state of Wei naturally agrees to fight against Qin. Isn't this leading the army to attack Qin's territory?" Wei Wang faintly dripped sweat from his forehead, a little flustered.

"But the defenders of Dongjun County have already been defeated by our imperial army. They have already become the meat of our imperial army. Does King Wei want to grab food?" Zhong Yu's tone was full of bad intentions. .

"Of course not, but Dongjun is indeed a lost territory of our country Wei, how can it be easily abandoned!" Asked by Zhong Yu, King Wei was a little flustered.

King Wei was very clear about the fighting power of the imperial army, and he naturally understood the gap between Wei and them. Seeing that the people in front of him seemed to want to fight if they disagreed, how could King Wei not be afraid?

"East County is indeed the territory of the State of Wei, and our Yu State has no intention of invading it. It's just that we and other countries are fighting bloody battles with the Qin army in the front, while you, the State of Wei, are hiding behind and carefully picking up the cheap. , how can there be such a good thing in the world?" Zhong Yu shook his head, calming the panicked King Wei slightly.

"Then, according to His Royal Highness King Jing, what should we do in Wei?" Hearing that Zhong Yu in front of him didn't seem to want to snatch Dongjun, King Wei was overjoyed and asked cautiously.

"I don't want the territory of Dongjun, but this time I sent troops to attack Qin, and I Yuguo did a great job. Not only as the initiator of the alliance, but also sending 300,000 troops, which can be said to be the greatest contribution. Does the king of Wei have any objection?" Zhong Yu didn't directly answer the unfinished question, but asked him a question.

"Of course, among all the countries and within the alliance, the contribution of Yu Guo should be the most important!" King Wei nodded his head heavily and said in agreement.

If there is no such bridge from the Yu Kingdom, I am afraid that among the various countries, there is really no one who has the courage and ability to put such pressure on Qin, and it looks like it may be destroyed at any time.

"Well, since the king of Wei also recognizes the contribution of my imperial country, I will say it directly! In the world of Qin, I don't want their land, because the land area of my imperial country is several times that of Qin, and it is extremely vast. , there is no shortage of these." Nodding in satisfaction, Zhong Yu began to talk about his plan.

"What, your country doesn't want Qin's territory, so why did you send troops? It can't be just to attack Qin!" Wei Wang was surprised and said in disbelief.

"That's natural, it's true, my country has a lot of land, and there is no shortage of doing something, what is really lacking is people who develop these lands!" Nodding his head, Zhong Yu said confidently.

"Human?" Wei Wang was surprised, not quite understanding.

"That's right, it's people. What our country lacks is not land, but population. In terms of all countries in the world, there are often more than 10,000 people living in a county, but our country has only a thousand people. Large and sparsely populated. There are only so few people to live in such a vast land, and it is extremely difficult to rule and control, so the population of Qin State in the south is needed to fill it!" Zhong Yu nodded and said his own Yuguo's difficulties and desires.
